version_strings.where: fw_dec.bin image header block @0x40 (uImage-embedded version info, NUL-separated fields)

notes: Firmware is SHRS-encrypted (new D-Link scheme, AES-128-CBC). Decrypted with the public 0xricksanchez/dlink-decrypt PoC; the AES key C05FBF1936C99429CE2A0781F08D6AD8 (derived from static blobs inside the on-device imgdecrypt) is still valid for 1.11b01. All three embedded SHA512 integrity checks (enc-payload, dec-payload, dec-payload+key) passed.
SHRS header layout: len_no_padding@0x4=18080638, len_padded@0x8=18080640, IV@0xC=67c6697351ff4aec29cdbaabf2fbe346, SHA512s @0x1C/0x5C/0x9C, 512B zero pad, 2x512B signature, ciphertext@0x6DC.

Extraction chain: SHRS decrypt -> uImage (Linux/MIPS, LZMA, load 0x81001000, built 2020-01-06) -> vmlinux.bin 23550400 bytes -> LZMA blob @0x8834EC (dict 32MB, size -1) -> 70373888-byte cpio(newc) initramfs -> rootfs. No squashfs: rootfs is a kernel-embedded initramfs (Realtek SDK).
Decrypted artifacts kept in scratch: fw_dec.bin (AES plaintext image), vmlinux.bin (uncompressed kernel), rootfs_blob.bin (cpio archive).
9965 high-entropy trailing bytes appended after the SHRS ciphertext in the .bin (post signature/metadata; not part of the AES container).

CVE-2021-28144 path present: /bin/prog.cgi (1061332 bytes, MIPS32 rel2 LSB ELF) with symlinks etc_ro/lighttpd/www/web/HNAP1/prog.cgi and prog.fcgi -> /bin/prog.cgi. Web stack: lighttpd (etc_ro/lighttpd/) + HNAP1 CGI + FastCGI.
rootfs is Realtek SDK / OpenWrt Barrier Breaker based (etc/banner, BusyBox 1.22.1, kernel 3.10.14); file count 1643 regular files + 263 symlinks.
Leftover cross-model string 'DIR-878' in bin/rc data blob @0x83a38 (shared SDK code default, not a version contradiction).
bin/prog.cgi embeds '/bin/imgdecrypt /tmp/firmware.img' (on-device firmware decryption during upgrade) and fota server api.fota.dlink.com.
